column2: #changed dge$samples so that the row names case/control# are now a column within the dataframe
#joined dge_samples to mds_tibble to now include donorid in the tibble
mds_tibble <- mds_tibble |> left_join(dge_samples |> dplyr::select(sample, donorid), by = "sample")
mds_tibble_joined <- mds_tibble |> left_join(PRS |> dplyr::select(donorid, Polygenic_risk_score), by = "donorid")
#plot of MDS with colour gradient of PRS
ggplot(mds_tibble_joined, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = Polygenic_risk_score)) +
point.padding = 0.2) + # label samples, reduce overlap between labels
scale_colour_gradient(low = "#D96B5F",high = "#4C84A6") + # Keep colours consistent across plots
